description.value: Firehouse Subs is a North American sandwich chain known for its hot, steamed subs and a charitable foundation that has donated over $6.3 million to Canadian first responders. This Delta location offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering. For a touring cyclist on Scott Road / 120th Street, it provides a reliable, high-calorie refuelling stop in a busy suburban corridor.

OSM lists the street as 'Scott Road' while the website uses '120th Street' — these are dual names for the same road in Delta/Surrey. The website footer lists a 'Gluten Free Roll' option, providing evidence of GF menu items; no bike parking, washroom, or Wi-Fi details appear anywhere in the fetched content.
